description.en: Through-the-scope clip placement to close the mucosotomy; recognition when advanced closure (OTS clip, endoscopic suturing) is needed.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for mucosal closure with clips but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs mucosal closure with clips independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches mucosal closure with clips to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
